prompt.zh-TW: 晨霧茶行今年的營收是 {{money:vars.revenue}}，本期淨利是 {{money:vars.netIncome}}。純益率是多少？以百分比作答，取到小數點後兩位。
prompt.en: Morning Mist Tea had revenue of {{money:vars.revenue}} this year and a profit for the period of {{money:vars.netIncome}}. What is its net profit margin? Answer as a percentage with two decimal places.

explanation.zh-TW: 純益率 ＝ 本期淨利 ÷ 營收 ＝ {{money:vars.netIncome}} ÷ {{money:vars.revenue}} ＝ {{percent:expected.answer.value}}（簡化版，兩個數字都來自同一年的損益表）。它是杜邦拆解的第一個因子：每一元生意最後留下多少。
explanation.en: Net profit margin = profit for the period ÷ revenue = {{money:vars.netIncome}} ÷ {{money:vars.revenue}} = {{percent:expected.answer.value}} (simplified version; both figures come from the same year’s income statement). It is the first DuPont factor: how much of each unit of revenue is kept as profit.
